back: The angles opposite each other where two straight lines cross. They are equal.
A line that crosses two or more other lines.
In the same position at each crossing (F shape). They are equal.
Between the parallel lines, on opposite sides of the transversal (Z shape). They are equal.
Between the parallel lines, on the same side of the transversal (C shape). They add to 180°.

front: How can you prove two lines are parallel?
back: Show that corresponding angles are equal, alternate angles are equal, or co-interior angles add to 180°.

front: How are parallel lines marked on a diagram?
back: With matching arrowheads on each line.
